lead.text: *The compact set of questions that runs underneath everything.*
The following pages contain the entire operating system of a Resourceful Human, compressed into a set of questions you can ask yourself in any situation.
Print them. Fold them. Carry them. Read them once a week for a year. Notice which ones you skip.

rows: What don't I know? And who does?
Where is the best evidence — and did I go there?
What matters most in the next 90 minutes?
Should I respond right now — or in an hour?
What is the underlying fear or need I am not addressing?
What do they see that I don't?
What did reality just teach me?
What is the next useful thing I can do?
What actually matters here? Not to the world — to me.
What is the smallest possible version of the right thing?
What is the calm version of the sentence I want to say?
Who is the room really deferring to — and what do they know?
Who does this shortcut make me? And can I live with them?
Would I advise my child to do this? Would I be comfortable if it were public?
Am I building the life I want to have looked back on?

lead.text: You will not always have the right answer. You will often have the right question. The question is where the practice begins.
*“The OS is a set of questions. The practice is asking them.”*
